question: Program studi apa saja yang tersedia di SEMUA jalur pendaftaran SPMB (5 jalur)?
expected_claim: Sarjana Terapan Keperawatan adalah satu-satunya program studi yang tersedia di seluruh 5 jalur.
graph_verification_method: Direct Cypher: MATCH (p:ProgramStudi)-[:TERSEDIA_PADA]->(j:JalurPendaftaran) RETURN p.name, j.name, aggregated by p.name
live_graph_result: Only 'Sarjana Terapan Keperawatan' has all 5 TERSEDIA_PADA edges (Jalur Mandiri, SPMB Bersama, SPMB Mandiri Profesi, SPMB Mandiri Reguler SMA, SPMB Prestasi); next-closest programs have only 4.
notes: Confirmed correct against live production Neo4j 2026-07-31.

question: Program studi D-III Keperawatan bisa didaftar melalui jalur pendaftaran apa saja?
expected_claim: SPMB Bersama, SPMB Mandiri Reguler SMA, SPMB Prestasi; TIDAK tersedia di Jalur Mandiri maupun SPMB Mandiri Profesi.
graph_verification_method: Same Cypher query, filtered to p.name = 'D-III Keperawatan'
live_graph_result: D-III Keperawatan has exactly 3 TERSEDIA_PADA edges: SPMB Bersama, SPMB Mandiri Reguler SMA, SPMB Prestasi. No edge to Jalur Mandiri or SPMB Mandiri Profesi.
notes: Confirmed correct against live production Neo4j 2026-07-31.

question: D-III Kesehatan Gigi dan D-III Sanitasi hanya bisa didaftar melalui jalur apa?
expected_claim: Kedua program studi HANYA tersedia melalui SPMB Prestasi.
graph_verification_method: Same Cypher query, filtered to the 2 program names
live_graph_result: Both D-III Kesehatan Gigi and D-III Sanitasi actually have 2 TERSEDIA_PADA edges each: SPMB Mandiri Reguler SMA AND SPMB Prestasi -- NOT exclusive to SPMB Prestasi as the gold answer claims.
notes: REAL FINDING: the gold-QA expected answer's exclusivity claim ('hanya SPMB Prestasi') is contradicted by the live graph, which shows both programs also reachable via SPMB Mandiri Reguler SMA. Either the gold-dataset ground truth needs correction, or this specific graph edge is a mis-extraction -- not determined which in this session; flagged for the thesis author to resolve before citing MH03 as a GraphRAG success case.

question: Persyaratan dokumen apa yang diwajibkan di SEMUA jalur pendaftaran?
expected_claim: KTP, ijazah, surat pernyataan/kesanggupan diwajibkan di kelima jalur.
graph_verification_method: Direct Cypher: MATCH (j:JalurPendaftaran)-[:MENGHARUSKAN]->(p:Persyaratan) RETURN j.name, p.name
live_graph_result: 'KTP', 'ijazah', and 'surat' each have a MENGHARUSKAN edge from all 5 JalurPendaftaran nodes (Jalur Mandiri, SPMB Bersama, SPMB Mandiri Profesi, SPMB Mandiri Reguler SMA, SPMB Prestasi) -- exact match, no gaps. (Other Persyaratan nodes -- 'tinggi badan', 'sehat jasmani', 'buta warna' -- are NOT universal across all 5, e.g. SPMB Bersama lacks 'sehat jasmani' and 'buta warna', consistent with the question only claiming KTP/ijazah/surat as universal.)
notes: Confirmed correct against live production Neo4j 2026-07-31.

question: Apakah jalur SPMB Mandiri Profesi mensyaratkan tes buta warna?
expected_claim: Ya, menurut dokumen sumber (istilah 'butawarna' tanpa spasi).
graph_verification_method: Already documented in graphrag_multihop_dataset.jsonl's own notes field as a deliberate known-gap probe, re-verified 2026-07-25 per that file
live_graph_result: Neo4j's MENGHARUSKAN relation for SPMB Mandiri Profesi does NOT include buta warna/tinggi badan (confirmed extraction gap: source text uses concatenated 'butawarna', keyword extraction expects 'buta warna').
notes: Pre-existing, already-documented graph-extraction gap -- not re-verified in this session, cited from the dataset's own notes. This is the correct answer being available via Vector RAG despite GraphRAG's known miss.

question: Program studi apa yang HANYA ada di SPMB Prestasi dan tidak ada di Jalur Mandiri?
expected_claim: D-III Keperawatan, D-III Kesehatan Gigi, D-III Sanitasi tersedia di SPMB Prestasi tapi tidak di Jalur Mandiri.
graph_verification_method: Same Cypher query, checked absence of Jalur Mandiri edge for the 3 named programs
live_graph_result: None of the 3 programs (D-III Keperawatan, D-III Kesehatan Gigi, D-III Sanitasi) has a TERSEDIA_PADA edge to Jalur Mandiri -- claim holds (note: this question only asserts 'not in Jalur Mandiri', unlike MH03's stronger 'only in Prestasi' claim).
notes: Confirmed correct against live production Neo4j 2026-07-31.
